notes.title: Update notes for patch v1.24.12.13.0
notes.content: -Fixed bug that would cause save file to not properly load if you started the game, talked to prophetbot, picked up his friend profile, closed the game window without saving (closing WME's window), and then tried to launch the OneShot application in TWM.  This bug could technically be encountered on other maps where a collectible spawns in after a cutscene but this was the most likely place for it to be encountered due to the autosave that occurs after the prophetbot dialogue.

notes.title: OneShot: World Machine Edition Adds Community Items!
notes.content:
Hello OneShot fans!

The success of OneShot: World Machine Edition on Steam has left us all overwhelmed by the love that our fans have for the game.

So of course, we wanted to give you all something to celebrate the momentous support we've received.

Unfortunately, we've still not figured out a way to send a stack of delicious fluffy pancakes topped with butter and a decadently sweet syrup through Steam, so instead, we've decided it is the perfect time to add Community Items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182017/e885e46d9476e2d100de75902af4239cb65babe0.png[/img]

We've added Cards, Badges, Profile Backgrounds, & Emoticons to give your presence on Steam an extra OneShot flavor!

We hope you all enjoy these new additions, and will forgive us for not being able to send those pancakes!

And once again, thank you all for the tremendous support that OneShot has received over the years!

notes.title: Update notes for patch v1.24.11.22.1
notes.content:
v1.24.11.22.1
-adding support for loading demo save data and unlocking any achievements/badges that were earned in demo

notes.title: Update notes for patch v1.24.11.19.0
notes.content:
v1.24.11.19.0
-Added save redundancy system for most save files, so that 2 backups of save files will be kept in case of issues involving save corruption.
-Also added better error handling for loading save files and settings files, which should hopefully take care of the occasional "object reference not set to an instance" bug that was seen occasionally.
-Removed Wallpaper and Theme selectors from Customization App since most people change these from the Wallpaper and Theme folders on the desktop anyways.
-Added V-sync toggle and "Badge Notifications" toggle to Customization App.
-Added option to turn off fullscreen borders on OneShot window when maximized.
-Also added another fullscreen scaling option for OneShot window when maximized, "integer", which will scale the oneshot screen to the highest whole number multiple it can fit on the screen (for example, in 1080p resolution it will scale the OneShot screen to 1280x960, a 2x multiple).
-Fixed rare softlock that could occur when using the bell in the secret ram room.
-Added special characters for European name input screens and Russian name input screen, to better support the languages' characters.
-Fixed minor graphical bug where certain rooms (like Maize's room) would show as blank/collision tiles for the first frame of a map transition.
-Fixed minor graphical bug where fireflies wouldn't show up in Glen maps until 2 frames after the map transition began.

notes.title: Update notes for patch 1.24.10.7.1
notes.content:
v1.24.10.7.1
-Fixed issue where you could automash all 1-button modal windows, now only modal windows spawned by the OneShot window can be automashed.
-Fixed issue where modal windows could spawn offscreen if parent window was partially offscreen.
-Fixed issue where sounds were still playing at 100% volume for a brief moment (1ms or less?), even if sound effect volume was set to 0.
-Made dragging of files/icons have some tolerance before starting a drag, to avoid issue where when using the touchscreen or trackpad and clicking on an icon you could very easily accidentally grab it by mistake.
-Fixed issue where when using Steam Deck touch screen game would sometimes register the touchscreen click before the cursor position update, causing weird behavior where you wouldn't be clicking where your finger currently was but where it was before.

notes.title: ONESHOT: WORLD MACHINE EDITION AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
OneShot: World Machine Edition, a completely reimagined and expanded version of the highly-rated puzzle adventure game, is available now for PC and Steam Deck. Grab it on Steam this week and save during the launch celebration.  

KOMODO and Future Cat have teamed up to deliver a fully upgraded and expanded version of one of the highest user-rated games of all time, built on an entirely new engine with enhanced graphics, new UI, support for more platforms, and more. 

The original title has gained something of a cult following and some of the highest user reviews on Steam for its world-bending puzzles, intriguing denizens, surreal environments, and captivating story that reveals the truth of the game's reality.

Players will interact with a strange computer operating system that is a window into an alternate world. Together with Niko, a child who is also a stranger in this place, they work to rekindle the long dead sun and – hopefully – save everyone.

Features:
[list]
[*] Puzzles that require you to explore both the reality Niko inhabits, as well as your own.
[*] Amazing Original Soundtrack from Nightmargin, ft Eliza Velasquez and GIRakaCHEEZER
[*] Charming Pixel Artwork courtesy of Nightmargin and Eliza Velasquez
[*] NEW For World Machine Edition: Character Profile "Friends" Gallery, with bonus writing by Noxid
[*] NEW For World Machine Edition: Cutscene Gallery
[*] NEW For World Machine Edition: Colorful wallpapers for the World Machine desktop, featuring many guest artists
[*] NEW For World Machine Edition: Music Box
[*] NEW For World Machine Edition: Full Analog Movement Control support
[*] NEW For World Machine Edition: Support for Steam Deck!
[/list]

Available now on Steam for PC and Steam Deck, OneShot: WME has a standard price of $9.99 (US), but is being offered for just $7.99 (US) to new players and $4.99 (US) during launch week for those who own the original on Steam.

notes.title: OneShot: World Machine Edition will bring the quietly beloved RPG to Steam Deck
notes.content:
I can't read the title of OneShot without hearing Eminem singing "do not miss your chance to blow" immediately afterwards. But this mental deficiency is probably not shared by the thousands of folks who fell in love with the purple-tinted puzzle RPG in 2016. If you are among that number, and fancy a handheld way to replay the game, then good news. OneShot: World Machine Edition is a remastered version that is Steam Deck compatible, and it's coming out on PC this month.
